about: Where the Yozora look's pictures come from: each world's grounds (stills from a Makoto Shinkai film on TMDB's image CDN, by their file there) and its navigator (a character's portrait on AniList's CDN). Every Sol app fetches what is missing into ~/.local/share/sol-yozora/ when it starts (sol_quick::look_art), and scripts/yozora-art.sh reads the same list. The pictures belong to their makers and are never copied into a repository; this list holds only where they are.
